# Cameo — account brief

## Who
Cameo sells personalized video messages from actors, athletes, musicians, and other celebrities ([source](https://cameo.com/)). Its GitHub org lists cameo.com as the company site ([source](https://github.com/cameo)).

## Production Expo signals
- eas.json is present in cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json))
- react-native 0.74.5 in cameo/cameo-app/package.json ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json))
- CI workflows exist in cameo/cameo-app ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- The org has 31 public repos and 240 followers ([source](https://github.com/cameo))
- cameo/cameo-app was last pushed 2026-08-12 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app))
- The App Store listing has 95,000 ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408))
- 4 App Store releases shipped in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408))

## Why now
The app shipped 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)). The repo was last pushed 2026-08-12 and is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app)) ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener
I noticed cameo-app has an eas.json checked in, so you are already building with EAS ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/blob/main/eas.json)). You also run GitHub Actions workflows in the same repo and have shipped 4 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://github.com/cameo/cameo-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)) ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cameo-personal-videos/id1258790408)). At that release cadence, is anything in your build or submission pipeline still a manual step you would rather automate?
